jina: Provisions concerning appointment to offices in the public service
maudhui: (1) For purposes of interpreting the provisions of this Constitution concerning appointments to offices in the service of the Government of the United Republic, a person empowered by this Constitution to appoint or elect another person to an office also has power to appoint or elect a person to act in or temporarily hold and perform the functions of that office; provided that this shall not apply to the offices of Minister, Deputy Minister, Justice of Appeal, Judge of the High Court, member of the Commission for Human Rights and Good Governance or member of the Electoral Commission. (2) The following rules shall also apply: (a) where a person holding an office under this Constitution is on leave pending relinquishment of that office, another person may be appointed to the office notwithstanding the continued tenure of the first person; (b) where two or more persons concurrently hold the same office because of an appointment under paragraph (a), the person most recently appointed shall, when any function of the office is to be performed, be regarded as the sole holder of that office; and (c) where a person has been appointed under this Constitution to act in or hold an office while the substantive holder is unable to perform its functions, the validity of the acting appointment shall not be questioned on the ground that the substantive holder was not unable to perform those functions.
